_what_this_is: The measured readings the shipped prompt and operating point rest on, copied out of the session that produced them. Nothing in this repository re-derives them: there is no inference here, no model, no download.
_where_they_come_from: session s_261023_1731_109509b5 (tmp/work), run 2026-10-24 on the host's own laptop
_why_this_file_exists: four of the scripts that produced these numbers print them and write no file (validate.py, round3.py, lang.py, zhconfirm.py), so the figures survived only in that session's transcript; this file is the persisted copy

model.vision_projector: not shipped: vision was measured 2026-10-25 and came up short — 25/32 at the 0.600 cut across the two image sets in calibration/vision/ (src/README.md line 25)

operating_point.ask: q6 — "Do you need to do something about this message? Answer act or ignore."
operating_point.how: validate.py swept thresholds in steps of 0.025 over 1/40..39/40 and reported the best; 0.600 is that best, on a set written after every prompt choice had been made

LFM2.5-VL-450M Q4_K_M.note: the ≤300 MB target was withdrawn because of readings like this one

Qwen3.5-0.8B Q4_K_M.note: run in this pass at 6 and 4 shots with a different ask, not at q6 zero-shot, so it contributes no figure to the shipped cut

language_split._what: zhconfirm.py, pooled Chinese cases across all four sets (44 of them: 16 act, 28 other), and the same model asked in English
language_split._why_it_matters: one model, two languages, two different usable cuts — so a single global cut is a choice, not a measurement

LFM2.5-VL-450M Q4_K_M.note: below chance in Chinese and above it in English: the model inverts, which is why it was not shipped

how_the_probability_was_read._load_bearing: the measurement and the runtime do not read the same estimator today, and this file says so rather than smoothing it over
how_the_probability_was_read.measurement: vocab.py built a map keyed by the tokeniser's decoded text with .strip().lower(), so ids_for('act') returns every id whose decoding strips to 'act' — six of them for this checkpoint (598, 901, 3619, 7372, 15674, 32234). P(act) was the sum over all of them, and P(ignore) likewise, normalised over the pair.
how_the_probability_was_read.runtime: bindOptions (src/watch.ts) requires the option to survive as exactly ONE token past the prompt and masks that single id, which is what agent-lifecycle.md §4 line 79 asks for.
how_the_probability_was_read.consequence: the shipped cut was chosen under a summed-over-variants estimator and is applied under a single-id one. That is a stated open tension, not a settled fact — docs/decisions.md carries it with the word that would change it. It is also why a replacement model must clear the same measurement before it ships: the number is only meaningful together with the way it was read.

what_was_not_measured: vision: no image case was ever run; the requirement stands unmet
a box holding more than one message: the measured shape is one message at a time, so a multi-entry box is an extrapolation from the same ask
per-room summary variation: every measured run used one fixed digest string
